Help and support

Privacy policy · Terms of use

Built for developers

Clear build clutter.
Make room for your next project.

Build output, debug and release folders, project dependencies such as node_modules, package caches, and Xcode DerivedData can accumulate over time. Review accessible developer files and choose which rebuildable files to remove.

Folder access is required. Some locations remain protected by macOS; simulator and runtime cleanup are unavailable in the App Store version.

01 / DISCOVER

Find what takes up space

Review large and unused files, explore Downloads by type, and compare file contents to find identical copies.

02 / DECIDE

Review before cleaning

See results before taking action. Move selected personal files to the Trash, or remove selected rebuildable caches and build files. Cleanup requires Pro.

03 / STAY AWARE

Keep an eye on clutter

Pro adds scheduled scans and notifications at your chosen storage threshold. Checks run while the app is open and never delete files automatically.

A look inside Pristine Disk

Start with a free scan

Manual scans and result previews are free. Pro unlocks cleanup and scheduled checks. Planned US pricing is $4.99 monthly or $24.99 annually, with a 7-day free trial for eligible subscribers. Final localized prices, offer eligibility and renewal terms appear in Apple's purchase screen when subscriptions become available.

Scans run locally. Access is limited to locations authorized by you and permitted by macOS. Back up important files before cleaning; some cleanup actions permanently remove selected files.
